description: Query a previously created Nexscope media-generation task. Call the generation tool only once, wait at least 5 seconds before the first query, and use progressive backoff of 5, 10, 20, then 30 seconds while status is PENDING or RUNNING. Stop on SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or TIMEOUT. Successful results contain final Nexscope resource URLs and count contains the actual charged credits.

skillSlug.description: Slug of the asynchronous media-generation skill that created the task. Use the exact slug associated with the original generation tool.

taskId.description: Exact taskId returned in structuredContent by the original generation tool call. Never invent or replace this value.
